name: Baby Jogger City Select (Double Mode)

recall.note: No recall on the City Select stroller itself. Baby Jogger's 2013 CPSC recall covered the Select/Versa car-seat ADAPTER (support bars failing, car seats falling) — not the stroller.

notes: City Select in double mode (second seat added); ~37 lb with both seats, per-seat max 45 lb. On Clek's list via City Select adapter 2013551 (x2) plus the City Select Second Seat adapter 2011985 — both DISCONTINUED per Clek, with the lowest-handle-position car-seat caveat. Unfolded 43.5 x 25.8 x 41.5 in reflects the shared City Select frame footprint (Strollberry 105.5 x 65.5 x 110.5-119 cm, h x w x l); double mode adds a stacked second seat that raises overall height above the 41.5 in frame figure — no distinct published double-mode height. MSRP ~$499.99 reference.
